text:
katie (PM): Quick sync — need to lock MVP cutline for Milestone 5 by EOD Fri. My proposed cuts: drop tenant-level analytics (pilot later), defer advanced SAML for multi-tenant SSO to v1, keep embeddings cache and basic SSO. Thoughts?
omar (eng): +1 to cutting tenant analytics. Saves ~3 infra sprints. We should call out migration cost for customers currently on the pipeline.
jia (eng-ml): embeddings cache is high-impact for latency — strong +1 to keep. Without it 95p latency doubles for short queries.
sam (design): multi-tenant SSO removal hurts onboarding for some enterprise flows. Can we ship basic SSO + a stubbed post-setup flow so UX doesn't regress?
mike (product-ops): FYI customers ACME+BetaCorp asked for tenant analytics. If we cut, need a comms plan + workaround. Recommend a staged feature flag.
katie (PM): Proposal: ship basic SSO + embeddings cache in MVP, mark tenant analytics as "pilot/backlog" with a clear ETA for v1. Create a customer-facing doc explaining staging. Agree?
lauren (sales): Staged approach ok if we give BetaCorp a roadmap date and offer migration support. I can negotiate a pilot for them.
omar (eng): I'll draft a reduced infra scope: (1) remove multi-tenant analytics ETL, (2) keep cache infra, (3) implement staged feature flag for analytics. Patch list:
```
- infra/etl: remove tenant-aggregates job
- infra/cache: reserve 2 nodes for embeddings cache
- auth: basic OIDC only, remove multi-tenant SAML v2 flow
- rollout: feature_flag analytics-pilot
```
katie (PM): perfect. Can you attach rough ETA by tomorrow noon? Need to update milestone board before PM sync.
jia (eng-ml): also: recommend we add one eval metric to guard quality when caching — i.e., RPS vs duplicate-rate. I'll add an eval PR.
sam (design): I'll make the onboarding copy edits and add the stubbed post-setup flow screens. Won't block dev.
mike (product-ops): I'll draft the comms + customer playbook. Want legal looped for BetaCorp pilot terms.
release-bot: Deploy window for Milestone 5 is still target: 1829100000. Please confirm any changes to release checklist by EOD.
katie (PM): Next steps: Omar ETA tomorrow noon, Jia eval PR today, Sam copy + stubs by EOD, Mike comms draft by EOD. I'll update the milestone tracker and ping execs. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
lauren (sales): I'll prep BetaCorp runway and share ask list by EOD.
omar (eng): Ack — will post ETA + updated task list in this thread.
